channel.title: Particle incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Particle's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Connectivity Disruption — Tachyon Devices [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved. All Tachyon devices have successfully reconnected and connectivity has been fully restored.
Our team identified the root cause and implemented a fix, confirming full recovery across the affected fleet.
No other Particle device type or SKU was affected by this incident.
